product_metadata.title: Yield Pomelo Incense Sticks - Bergamot, Currant, & Himalayan Salt - Handmade, Calming Incense Stick Pack - Non Toxic Incense Made with Essential Oils - 1 Hour Burn Time - 15 Incense Sticks
features: WOODSY & WARM: Notes of Amyris, Coriander, & Amber. This Sandalwood incense pack exudes soft tones of santal over a base of warm amber undertones. Feels like: a warm cup of tea on a chilly day in the cabin

HANDMADE WITH ESSENTIAL OILS: This incense pack contains 15 non toxic incense sticks handmade in our Florida studio with an essential oil and fragrance oil blend. Each insence stick is 10.5” L and has a 1 hour burn time
THE BOTANICAL COLLECTION: Candles and luxury incense with subtle yet distinct compositions inspired by a selection of our favorite arboreal and floral species

SUSTAINABLE, ETHICAL PRODUCTION: Beauty, sustainability and ethical production are not at odds–they must all be considered to create something of true worth. We at YIELD create timeless goods made for the beauty and benefit of people

FUNCTIONAL ELEGANCE: Distinctive, understated, and livable. YIELD’s products, ranging from furniture to jewelry, are available at hundreds of retailers and have been featured in publications such as the New York Times, Dwell, Sunset, SF Chronicle
